services.name: Nature/Dolphin Tours
services.desc: Travel through the Charleston Harbor and past historic landmarks on the way to the uninhabited Morris Island. In addition to marine animals, the Lowcountry waterways are home to many interesting species of birds including Great Blue Herons, Snowy Egrets, Eastern Brown Pelicans, and Least Terns. Experience these and other unique wildlife in their natural habitat. During a serene coastal cruise, our crew will pull crab pots full of exceptional gifts from the sea to add to our onboard “touch tank”. Licensed naturalists will explore the Morris Island beach with you and point out the fascinating sea life that is abundant in Charleston’s estuaries. Spend a relaxing afternoon in the salty air,

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Climb aboard the Palmetto, our 45ft catamaran versatile enough to handle the harbor’s waters smoothly. With a capacity of only 49 passengers, the cruise offers an intimate, personalized sightseeing excursion. Get up-close views of the historic Battery, the Ravenel Bridge, forts, barrier islands, and lighthouses. The Sunset Cruise is a relaxed, casual atmosphere with a friendly crew and good-time tunes. Our captain and mates are happy to answer questions or address personal needs so don’t hesitate to ask. services.name: Custom Charters
services.desc: Delight your group with an authentic Low Country Boil or barbecue on an uninhabited island. It starts when you board “The Palmetto” for a cruise through the harbor. Take in the sights while you enjoy refreshments of your choosing. When we arrive at the barrier island, the boat is beached and your guests step out onto the sandy shore, where they will feast on Low Country cuisine and view the breathtaking beach sunset. Perhaps your group would prefer a day trip including a catered picnic or box lunch on Morris Island. Spend the day on the water in the Charleston sunshine and dine on an uninhabited barrier island.
